**Finding: Compliant** — no redline proposed.

- **No MFN burdening us.** Searches for "most favo(u)red", "favorable/favourable", "best", "lowest", "third party", and the fee provisions turned up no obligation for The Deerskin Companies to give HDI terms no less favourable than those given to others, or to match third-party offers.
- **Fees are fixed, not MFN-linked.** Section 3.1 sets a flat 30% of Net Sales above $11,000/month, with no benchmarking or true-up against third-party arrangements.
- **The one "no less favorably" clause runs in our favour.** Section 1.8 requires *HDI* to promote the Site and Deerskin Products no less favorably than its own catalog titles — a vendor-side benefit we keep untouched per the redline guidance.
- **Section 6.1 noted but out of scope.** It is an exclusivity/non-participation covenant on us, not a most-favoured-nation obligation; it would fall under an exclusivity rule rather than MFN.
